prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm caramel complexion, early 20s goddess, BBW bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — most massive full-figure BBW body ever at absolute maximum in every dimension, hips so wide beyond proportion dominating the entire frame, bust so enormous overwhelming gravity, waist deeply snatched despite impossible volume, long straight copper red hair — full body deep purple-brown rosewood carved directly over her own form covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is not a garment, not a printed pattern, this is solid carved wood curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into dozens of fitted carved sections whose grain changes direction from one section to the next, each joint standing in a thin raised ridge catching its own soft glint and casting its own small shadow, nothing lying flat. Dense fitted sections — BLAZING deep purple-brown rosewood grain across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID near-black streaks running between the carved sections, with fine gold inlay lines tracing every joint between the sections, polished to a warm satin sheen, completely opaque, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on the outer hip, the other raised overhead — most extreme BBW bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, pointed platform stiletto pumps carved from the same rosewood, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts, while her body keeps its full original proportions — thick heavy thighs, wide full hips and a huge bust exactly as massive as before.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, stiletto nails each as long as her whole hand, carved from the same rosewood with a high polish.
Jewelry: a pearl choker and a long strand of pearls hanging low on her chest, a delicate silver body chain draped across her collarbones and down her torso, and a gold belly chain with a small pendant at her navel. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face and ears are NOT carved — they are real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Latina woman with high cheekbones, large dark eyes and full lips, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: deep smoky black eyeshadow blended far out beyond the eyes, a sharp black winged liner, long dramatic lashes, glossy black lips, sharply contoured cheekbones.

Background: a sunny seaside promenade of pale paving stones with a waist-high white railing, a lamp post and a row of normal-height park benches, bright blue sky and soft sea light, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
